hunks.baseline: The Head Elder felt the air tremble. In the same instant, he understood how much destructive power the spearhead shooting toward his chest carried.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder felt the air tremble. At the same instant, he grasped the destructive power behind the spearhead hurtling toward his chest.

hunks.baseline: A threat to his life he had felt only a handful of times. Every hair on his body stood on end, and the world slowed.
hunks.sol: He had felt his life threatened this keenly only a handful of times. Every hair on his body stood on end, and the world slowed.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung’s spear came from the front, while Jin Wikyung’s sword flew in from behind. The two brothers’ pincer attack meshed with perfect timing.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s spear came from the front, while Jin Wikyung’s sword flew in from behind. The two brothers’ coordinated attack came together with perfect timing.

hunks.baseline: A truly life-or-death moment.
hunks.sol: A true life-or-death moment.

hunks.baseline: The one jiazi of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone. It poured vitality into his aging muscles and woke his blood vessels. The change did not stop there.
hunks.sol: The one jiazi of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian surged through every limb and bone. It poured vitality into his aging muscles and awakened his meridians. The change did not stop there.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Energy that had risen nearly a foot—thirty centimeters—compressed to half its size.
hunks.sol: The Sword Energy that had extended nearly a foot compressed to half its length.

hunks.baseline: That was not a loss of power. It was condensation.
hunks.sol: But this was not a loss of power. It was a concentration of it.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Energy that had fluttered like a thread wrapped the entire blade and took the shape of another sword.
hunks.sol: The threadlike Sword Energy wrapped around the entire blade, taking the shape of another sword.

hunks.baseline: The symbol of the superhuman masters who had broken through the wall of the Peak realm and opened a great new domain.
hunks.sol: The symbol of those superhuman masters who had broken through the wall of the Peak realm and entered a greater domain.

hunks.baseline: It was still incomplete, only half-formed, but it was unmistakably Sword Force—the distilled essence of the martial arts the Head Elder had spent his life mastering.
hunks.sol: It was still incomplete, no more than half-formed, but it was unmistakably Sword Force—the culmination of the martial arts the Head Elder had spent his life mastering.

hunks.baseline: Even the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s ancestral treasure sword was cut apart, Sword Energy and all. Jin Wikyung’s internal energy scattered in an instant, and his insides were wrenched. His face went pale.
hunks.sol: Even the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s ancestral treasure sword was severed, Sword Energy and all. Jin Wikyung’s internal energy scattered in an instant, the shock wrenching his insides. His face went pale.

hunks.baseline: One stroke would have been enough to take his neck.
hunks.sol: A single stroke would have been enough to take his head.

hunks.baseline: He reached for the spear now almost at his chest. His wrinkled hand, too, was wrapped in a dazzling radiance of qi.
hunks.sol: He reached for the spearhead already closing on his chest. His wrinkled hand was likewise wrapped in a dazzling radiance of qi.

hunks.baseline: This, too, was an incomplete Palm Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
hunks.sol: It, too, was an incomplete Palm Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.

hunks.baseline: Until the vortex spilling from the spearhead swallowed him whole.
hunks.sol: Until the vortex pouring from the spearhead swallowed him whole.

hunks.baseline: A deathly silence settled. It felt as if the dozens of people here—or perhaps everyone standing on the battlefield—were watching us.
hunks.sol: A deathly silence descended. It felt as though the dozens gathered here—perhaps everyone on the battlefield—were watching us.

hunks.baseline: At the end of countless gazes, the Head Elder slowly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: At the center of countless gazes, the Head Elder slowly opened his mouth.

hunks.baseline: Even speaking the words brought on a vicious hunger. Every muscle in my body stung, and not a scrap of internal energy was left inside me.
hunks.sol: Even saying the words brought on a ravenous hunger. Every muscle in my body stung, and not a scrap of internal energy remained inside me.

hunks.baseline: Unlike with Jopil, I didn’t pass out or crumple pathetically to the ground.
hunks.sol: Unlike when I’d fought Jopil, I neither passed out nor collapsed pathetically to the ground.

hunks.baseline: I had grown enough to take One Annihilation’s side effects. And as much as I had grown, One Annihilation’s power had grown with me.
hunks.sol: I had grown strong enough to withstand One Annihilation’s side effects. And as I had grown, so had One Annihilation’s power.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder’s current state was proof of that.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s condition was proof of that.

hunks.baseline: He muttered it under his breath and pressed an acupoint on his shoulder.
hunks.sol: Muttering under his breath, he pressed an acupoint on his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: The bleeding stopped, but that was all. The arm ground to nothing by the vortex One Annihilation had unleashed did not come back.
hunks.sol: The bleeding stopped, but that was all. The arm ground away without a trace by One Annihilation’s vortex did not return.

hunks.baseline: “I never thought I’d end up one-armed at this age. Heh heh.”
hunks.sol: “I never thought I’d end up one-armed at my age. Heh heh.”

hunks.baseline: “You’ve got a frightening younger brother.”
hunks.sol: “You have a frightening younger brother.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung asked, his face wan,
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung asked, his face wan, “Does that child frighten you?”

hunks.baseline: “Does that child frighten you?”
Not a hint of hesitation. A smile bloomed over his pale face.
hunks.sol: There was not a hint of hesitation in his answer. A smile spread across his pale face.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder stared at that smile.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder stared at his smile.

hunks.baseline: “You’re a fairly impressive talent. Enough to shoulder the future of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”
hunks.sol: “You’re quite a capable man. Worthy of shouldering the future of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung reaching the Peak realm at twenty was one thing. Getting ranked that high myself was almost more than I could take, but…
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung had reached the Peak realm at twenty, so that was understandable. But ranking even me that highly was almost more praise than I could handle…

hunks.baseline: As if he’d read my mind, the Head Elder went on.
hunks.sol: As though he had read my mind, the Head Elder continued.

hunks.baseline: “Power is what you don’t even share with your own blood. When that time comes, will you still be so proud of your younger brothers?”
hunks.sol: “Power is the one thing a man will not share, even with his own blood. When the time comes, will you still be so proud of your younger brothers?”

hunks.baseline: The air around us went ice-cold in an instant.
hunks.sol: The air around us went cold in an instant.

hunks.baseline: Everyone facing the Head Elder at close range belonged to the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Cautious looks clung to my cheeks, then quietly slid away.
hunks.sol: Everyone confronting the Head Elder at close range belonged to the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Wary glances settled on my face, then quickly slipped away.

hunks.baseline: *Family Head? I have no intention of doing anything like that, you bastards.*
hunks.sol: *Family Head? I have no intention of becoming anything like that, you bastards.*

hunks.baseline: Bitterness and relief both sat in his voice. The Head Elder’s brow twitched.
hunks.sol: Bitterness and relief mingled in his voice. The Head Elder’s brow twitched.

hunks.baseline: “The reason you betrayed us. The reason a day like today happened.”
hunks.sol: “The reason you betrayed us. The reason today came to pass.”

hunks.baseline: A succession fight.
hunks.sol: A succession struggle.

hunks.baseline: It felt like a huge puzzle piece had clicked into place. The smaller pieces that still hadn’t found their spots were fitting together one by one through their conversation.
hunks.sol: It felt as though a huge piece of the puzzle had clicked into place. The smaller pieces still out of position began falling into place one by one as they spoke.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung asked in a respectful tone.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung asked respectfully.

hunks.baseline: The shift was so natural no one else there even noticed.
hunks.sol: The shift in his tone was so natural that no one else seemed to notice.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve heard nothing. Father never said a word about him.”
hunks.sol: “I have heard nothing. Father never spoke a word of him.”

hunks.baseline: “He was a cold man. Toward his children, and toward his only younger brother. And…”
hunks.sol: “He was a coldhearted man. Toward his children and his only younger brother alike. And…”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder gave a dry little laugh.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “He was a petty man. For a lot of reasons, we brothers, who had once been close, drifted apart. And then that happened.”
hunks.sol: “He was petty. For many reasons, we gradually drifted apart despite once being close brothers. Then it happened.”

hunks.baseline: “Have you heard of the Ten Myriad Demonic Forces? They came in endless waves. The Murim Alliance was formed, but it was only an alliance of the Nine Sects and One Gang, and they were too busy defending their own bases.”
hunks.sol: “Have you heard of the Hundred Thousand of the Demonic Path? They came in endless waves. The Murim Alliance was formed, but it was little more than a coalition of the Nine Sects and One Gang, each too busy defending its own territory.”

hunks.baseline: That was also when the Head Elder had begun making a real name for himself.
hunks.sol: That was also when the Head Elder had begun to make a name for himself.

hunks.baseline: Under the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s banner, he rallied Shanxi’s martial artists and finally drove out the Demonic Cult’s forces.
hunks.sol: He rallied Shanxi’s martial artists beneath the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s banner and ultimately drove out the Demonic Cult’s forces.

hunks.baseline: “The last battle was right here, at Eight Spring Gorge.”
hunks.sol: “The final battle took place right here, at Eight Spring Gorge.”

hunks.baseline: His gaze seemed to grope toward some distant point in the past.
hunks.sol: His gaze seemed to search some distant point in the past.

hunks.baseline: “It was a long war. Many people died, and everyone was exhausted. But there was hope, too. Hope that they could finally return to their families. The three hundred volunteers sworn to die all shared that same hope.”
hunks.sol: “It had been a long war. Many had died, and everyone was exhausted. But we still had hope—the hope that we could finally return to our families. All three hundred members of the death squad shared that hope.”

hunks.baseline: It was a glorious victory, and the reason the Head Elder was still remembered. Everyone had believed that without question.
hunks.sol: It was a glorious victory and the reason the Head Elder was still remembered to this day. Everyone had believed that without question.

hunks.baseline: Until just now.
hunks.sol: Until now.

hunks.baseline: “We fought as we fell back deep into the gorge, but we were hopelessly outnumbered. Even as I swung my sword like a madman, one question would not leave me.”
hunks.sol: “We fought while retreating deep into the gorge, but we were hopelessly outnumbered. Even as I swung my sword like a madman, one question refused to leave me.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder’s voice was unnervingly calm.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s voice was chillingly calm.

hunks.baseline: “How could they have set an ambush in advance? My elder brother should have been blocking the road into Eight Spring Gorge.”
hunks.sol: “How could they have prepared an ambush? My elder brother was supposed to be blocking the road to Eight Spring Gorge.”

hunks.baseline: Silent shock spread through the crowd. What little color was left in Jin Wikyung’s already pale face vanished.
hunks.sol: Silent shock rippled through the crowd. The last traces of color vanished from Jin Wikyung’s already pale face.

hunks.baseline: “The battle lasted half a day. We fought waiting for reinforcements that never came, and it was useless. Of the three hundred volunteers, only eight survived. When we finally returned to the family, I have never been able to forget the look on my brother’s face when he saw me.”
hunks.sol: “The battle lasted half a day. We fought while waiting for reinforcements that never came, but it was no use. Of the three hundred members of the death squad, only eight survived. When we finally returned to the family, I saw my brother’s face. I have never forgotten the look on it.”

hunks.baseline: “Enough time has passed for mountains and rivers to change several times over. Did you think I came this far on mere suspicion?”
hunks.sol: “Enough time has passed for mountains and rivers to change several times over. Did you think I had come this far on mere suspicion?”

hunks.baseline: Decades were more than enough to turn suspicion into certainty. The Head Elder laughed hollowly.
hunks.sol: Decades were more than enough time for suspicion to harden into certainty. The Head Elder laughed hollowly.

hunks.baseline: “My brother turned the war into an opportunity. I became a hero on the battlefield, but he became Family Head. Everyone who had followed me either died in battle or vanished afterward.”
hunks.sol: “My brother turned the war into an opportunity. I became a hero on the battlefield, but he became Family Head. By then, everyone who had followed me had either died or gone missing in battle.”

hunks.baseline: “Then going straight into the Council of Elders—was that why?”
hunks.sol: “Then was that why you entered the Council of Elders immediately afterward?”

hunks.baseline: “Because that was the only way he would feel at ease. The only way I and my people could stay alive.”
hunks.sol: “Because only then would he feel at ease. Because only then could my people and I remain alive.”

hunks.baseline: I thought back to what he had said. The eight survivors who had followed the Head Elder and lived to the end.
hunks.sol: I thought back to what he had said. Eight men had survived to the end alongside the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: Guessing who they were was not hard.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t difficult to guess who they were.

hunks.baseline: The survivors had sworn revenge. Revenge on the Family Head and the family that had betrayed them.
hunks.sol: The survivors had sworn revenge—revenge against the Family Head and the family that had betrayed them.

hunks.baseline: “It had been a very long wait.”
hunks.sol: “It has been a very long wait.”

hunks.baseline: Silence swallowed them. Disbelief, shock, shame. The feelings differed, but no one could easily speak.
hunks.sol: Silence swallowed everyone. Disbelief, shock, shame—their emotions differed, but no one could bring themselves to speak.

hunks.baseline: Well. No one except me.
hunks.sol: Well, no one except me.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t hold back the little snorts of laughter leaking out of me.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t hold back the little bursts of laughter escaping me.

hunks.baseline: “In the end, you’ve only got one goal.”
hunks.sol: “In the end, you only have one goal.”

hunks.baseline: I flicked my thumb at the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: I jerked my thumb at the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: “Revenge, my ass. You’re trying to become this, aren’t you?”
hunks.sol: “Revenge, my ass. You’re trying to become the man on top, aren’t you?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m right, aren’t I? Clear away everything in the way—the Jin Family of Taiyuan, the Mount Heng Sword Sect—and swallow Shanxi whole.”
hunks.sol: “I’m right, aren’t I? Get rid of everything in your way—the Jin Family of Taiyuan, the Mount Heng Sword Sect—and swallow Shanxi whole.”

hunks.baseline: I picked at my ear and went on.
hunks.sol: I picked at my ear and continued.

hunks.baseline: This had happened a full forty years ago. Even counting the Head Elder’s age, he had waited half his life.
hunks.sol: This had happened forty years ago. The Head Elder had waited half his life.

hunks.baseline: “How many of the people who stabbed you in the back are even still alive? There’s late, and then there’s this late. And please, I’m begging you—don’t start with that bullshit about a gentleman waiting ten years to take revenge.”
hunks.sol: “How many of the people who stabbed you in the back are even still alive? There’s being late, and then there’s this. And please, I’m begging you—don’t give me that bullshit about a junzi waiting ten years to take revenge.”

hunks.baseline: If holding out ten years made you a gentleman, did holding out forty make the Head Elder Jesus?
hunks.sol: If waiting ten years made you a junzi, did waiting forty make the Head Elder Jesus?

hunks.baseline: It was nothing more than a crazy old man’s self-justification.
hunks.sol: This was nothing more than a crazy old man trying to justify himself.

hunks.baseline: “You run your mouth just because you’ve got one.”
hunks.sol: “You speak recklessly simply because you have a mouth.”

hunks.baseline: “I did. What are you going to do about it?”
hunks.sol: “I do. What are you going to do about it?”

hunks.baseline: “Do I have to? After it’s gone this far?”
hunks.sol: “Do I need to? After things have gone this far?”

hunks.baseline: The question was so obvious I snorted a laugh and pointed at the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The question was so absurd that I snorted and pointed toward the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: A mountain of corpses, a sea of blood. Utter pandemonium. The scene in front of us was exactly that.
hunks.sol: A mountain of corpses and a sea of blood. Utter pandemonium. The scene before us was exactly that.

hunks.baseline: The chill in the Head Elder’s eyes wavered. But only for an instant.
hunks.sol: The cold light in the Head Elder’s eyes wavered. But only for an instant.

hunks.baseline: He muttered it like a jab at himself, then raised his sword.
hunks.sol: He muttered the words in self-mockery, then raised his sword.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s lips moved, and that was all.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s lips moved, but that was all.

hunks.baseline: A fight that ended only when one side died. They had come too far to turn back.
hunks.sol: This fight would end only when one side died. They had come too far to turn back.

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t about to decline.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t about to refuse.

hunks.baseline: I remembered the first day I saw the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: I remembered the day I first saw the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: A bearing and dignity that made his age meaningless. His white beard called an immortal to mind.
hunks.sol: His dignified bearing had made his age seem irrelevant. His flowing white beard brought an immortal to mind.

hunks.baseline: Of course, there were no immortals who mercilessly cut people in half.
hunks.sol: Of course, there probably weren’t many immortals who mercilessly cut people in half.

hunks.baseline: Drenched in blood, he swung his sword without pause. Looks mixed with awe and fear poured toward him.
hunks.sol: Drenched in blood, he swung his sword without pause. Everyone stared at him with a mixture of awe and fear.

hunks.baseline: He had lost an arm, but the Head Elder was still strong.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder had lost an arm, but he was still strong.

hunks.baseline: He just clearly wasn’t as strong as before.
hunks.sol: He was clearly no longer as strong as before, though.

hunks.baseline: *This is doable.*
hunks.sol: *We can do this.*

hunks.baseline: Peak master or not, the martial artists here were the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s elite. Men who had fought across the battlefield under Jin Wikyung, skilled enough to have survived the earlier clash with the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder might have been a Peak master, but the martial artists here were the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s elite. They had fought across the battlefield under Jin Wikyung and were skilled enough to have survived their earlier clash with the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder knocked aside blades driving in from every direction, his face darkening. In the old days, he would have cut down everything in his path with Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder knocked away the blades driving at him from every direction, his face darkening. Before, he would have used Sword Energy to cut through everything in his path.

hunks.baseline: Proof that the internal energy that had once seemed like a spring that never ran dry had finally hit bottom.
hunks.sol: It was proof that the internal energy that had once seemed like an inexhaustible spring was finally running dry.

hunks.baseline: Sword wounds began to multiply across the Head Elder’s body. Unlike before, most of the blood was his.
hunks.sol: Sword wounds began to multiply across the Head Elder’s body. Unlike before, most of the blood was now his.

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t about to miss that opening. The spear I drove with everything I had tore a handful of flesh from his side.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t about to miss that opening. I drove my spear forward with all my strength, tearing a handful of flesh from his side.

hunks.baseline: Even through the pain, the Head Elder cut down a martial artist and charged me. He meant it this time; a faint Sword Energy gathered along the swinging blade.
hunks.sol: Even through the pain, the Head Elder cut down another martial artist and lunged at me. He had clearly set his mind on killing me; faint Sword Energy gathered along his swinging blade.

hunks.baseline: “I’d forgotten you were there.”
hunks.sol: “I’d forgotten about you.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder turned with a twisted face.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder turned, his face twisting.

hunks.baseline: “Did my elder brother teach you to put a knife in someone’s back?”
hunks.sol: “Did my elder brother teach you to put a blade in someone’s back?”

hunks.baseline: “My family members are dying. Is a sneak attack really that important?”
hunks.sol: “My people are dying around me. Why should I care about a sneak attack?”

hunks.baseline: “Aren’t you ashamed, as a martial artist?”
hunks.sol: “Aren’t you ashamed as a martial artist?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung looked at the Head Elder with a complicated expression.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung regarded the Head Elder with a complicated expression.

hunks.baseline: “Please stop this meaningless fight.”
hunks.sol: “Please put an end to this meaningless fight.”

hunks.baseline: The flow of the battlefield had been ours for a long time. But the black-clad men kept resisting stubbornly, and the screams and corpses still showed no sign of thinning out.
hunks.sol: The battle had turned in our favor long ago. But the black-clad men continued their stubborn resistance, and the screams and corpses showed no sign of diminishing.

hunks.baseline: “You’re right. It may be a meaningless fight. But…”
hunks.sol: “You’re right. Perhaps this is a meaningless fight. But…”

hunks.baseline: The staggering Head Elder straightened his back. A sharp gleam was already flashing in his eyes, and a blade-like aura began to rise.
hunks.sol: The staggering Head Elder straightened his back. A sharp gleam flashed in his eyes, and a blade-like aura began to rise from him.

hunks.baseline: No. More than that. Someone suddenly came to mind.
hunks.sol: No. It was more than that. Someone suddenly came to mind.

hunks.baseline: The last sight of him as he was dying overlapped with the Head Elder now.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s current appearance overlapped with Jopil’s final moments before his death.

hunks.baseline: *Innate qi. He’s drawing up his innate qi.*
hunks.sol: *Innate qi. He’s drawing out his innate qi.*

hunks.baseline: If internal energy was acquired power, piled up by circulating qi and taking elixirs, innate qi was the opposite. It was the root of the human body—life force itself, for all intents.
hunks.sol: Internal energy was acquired power accumulated by circulating qi and consuming elixirs. Innate qi was the opposite—the foundation of the human body, life force itself.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder was staking his life to use it.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder was using his own life to fuel it.

hunks.baseline: He spat blood and raised his sword. His life was going out fast, but his sword shone more brilliantly than it ever had.
hunks.sol: He spat out blood and raised his sword. His life was fading rapidly, yet his sword shone more brilliantly than ever.

hunks.sol: The moment I saw that overwhelming sight, a single phrase slipped from my lips.

hunks.baseline: My heart pounded just from looking at it. I could feel a terrifying power that far outstripped Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: My heart pounded from the mere sight of it. I could feel a terrifying power that far surpassed Sword Energy.

hunks.baseline: His red eyes, the capillaries bursting one after another, locked on me.
hunks.sol: His blood-red eyes, their capillaries bursting one after another, locked on me.

hunks.sol: But the Head Elder had already vanished from where he stood.

hunks.baseline: An attack I couldn’t dodge or block.

hunks.baseline: I wrung every muscle in my body. The last scant handful of internal energy raced for the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: It was a final struggle, and a show of respect for the life I had lived so fiercely until now.
hunks.sol: It was a final struggle—the least I owed the life I had fought so hard to live.
